wing_name: AI Agent Turn, Then Mass File Deletion (Behaviour)
description: An AI agent worked on a request, and within 15 minutes at least 20 files were permanently deleted (UBA's file_deleted events, from the USN journal). An agent cleaning up after itself is common; one deleting a person's documents is not - the hit names the folder.
proves: Many files were permanently deleted while an AI agent was working
author: Crow-Eye Team

steps.label: An AI agent worked on a request
